answer: Mirror quorum admission. A fresh identity counts only after two unrelated veterans each rebuild a mirror of its first hundred actions, matching the chain byte for byte; they sign at a rotating jetty checkpoint, each sponsor posting a refundable bond forfeited if the newcomer is ruled fraudulent within thirty days. No pooling, no bulk rates: N fakes need N distinct sponsors and freeze N at-risk bonds. An attacker growing a fake meadow of agents pays full freight per head, while an honest agent replays once and pays one bond, never again.
